title: Read-only attendance and food response model candidates
phase: context-specific live observations for integration review

privacy.identifiersDatesNamesAndMenuText: redacted; no scalar private values are recorded
privacy.captureHandling: Private captures remain outside the repository under the local config directory. Summaries below contain field paths, runtime types, counts, and non-identifying equality relations only.

interpretation: Live observations describe only the selected account/context and the captured responses; they do not establish universal requiredness, nullability, enum domains, completeness, or server semantics.
For values observed only as null, the candidate keeps the modeled primitive type unknown rather than asserting a null-only or nullable contract.
Static client-read fields remain valid even when absent from a particular live sample. Empty arrays and empty objects do not prove global emptiness, absence semantics, or a complete empty schema.
The response bodies are distinguished from capture-envelope metadata. HTTP status/content-type envelope values are not modeled as body fields.
Wire-query templates below contain placeholders only; no child, institution, user, or date values are recorded.

requestObservation.staticCallerEvidence: The client constructs start_date/end_date from the selected month boundaries and formats both as Y-MM-DD; this does not prove server range inclusivity or timezone semantics.
requestObservation.querySerialization: No stronger URL serialization claim than the observed redacted template is made here.

candidateDisposition.recommendation: Keep the existing nine root paths open/optional and retain their existing unknown semantics where types or nested structures are unproved. Add this sample-backed days[] object/entry path inventory as partial client-context observation; it corrects the former raw-day-item unknown disposition. Keep observed-null leaves typed unknown in a universal model.
doNotInfer: Do not interpret access as a permission contract or publish its value.
Do not assign meanings to status, has_card_event, workday_holiday, workday_weekend, or default_status fields from their names or observed integer types.
Do not turn missing arrival/pickup fields, null total_time, an empty log result, or a date row into an absence/presence conclusion.
Do not treat the seven rows, their key uniformity, or their shared child identifier as a server completeness guarantee or a general branch inventory.

observations.staticEvidence: evidence/guardian-batch/attendance.json: GetChildCalendar response candidate and trace (#25644, #26402, #26394, #44368, #44393). samples.interpretation: An empty result for the requested current date only; it is not evidence that the child was absent or that the endpoint has no item shape.

One previously returned calendar date was selected because its calendar entry had a positive log_count; the query then returned one row. This establishes a linked, scoped observation, not a general log-count invariant or meaning for status/type.

requestObservation.serialization: The observed date was URL-encoded without changing the date text; the request carries one date, not a range.
requestObservation.staticCallerEvidence: #25650 builds params={date: p3}; the history caller supplies one selected date formatted YYYY-MM-DD. No range boundary or timezone interpretation is established.

candidateDisposition.recommendation: Retain the array response and static direct-read item fields. Add the sample-backed item keys and nested paths as partial observations; sample-only identity/id paths must not be presented as verified actor semantics. Record integer status and string item.type as observed for this row only, without enum meanings.
preserveStaticOnlyPaths: Keep any independently justified static-only item path, including diary_status.type if present in an integration candidate, as an optional/unobserved branch; it is absent from this single live item's diary_status object and must not be deleted on that basis.
The static top-level start_time and end_time reads remain valid despite being null in this sample; their UI use does not make them log event timestamps or arrival/pickup proof.
doNotInfer: An empty response array does not mean absence, no attendance, or a universally empty log.
The positive calendar log_count and one matching returned item do not prove all count/log consistency behavior.
Do not derive status/type labels or transitions from observed primitive types or UI labels.
Do not publish identifiable names, IDs, unique identifiers, or actual dates.

observations.staticEvidence: evidence/guardian-batch/attendance.json and evidence/responses/children-diary-files.json: GetStatusLogs; service #25650, caller/action #26404-#26405, consumer #43079. Static UI reads establish item paths independently of the empty sample.

requestObservation.serialization: Parent-observed URL-encoded form[user_id] query for this successful read. This single sample does not prove Axios serialization in general, that the server recognized/applied the parameter, or its filtering semantics.

doNotInfer: Do not publish the min_date value or assert its format, timezone, inclusivity, or server meaning.
Do not infer access/restrict flags or write permission from this body or the successful GET.

candidateDisposition.mealValues: Breakfast/lunch/supper were strings and dinner was null in all five sampled day objects. Do not publish their text, model null-only dinner as a universal null type, assert universal meal nullability, or infer structured dish/group semantics from the strings.

The empty uploaded_files array and null uploaded_file are sample-specific and do not establish that files are unavailable generally.
Do not publish actor IDs, institution IDs, menu contents, or actual date values.
Do not interpret integer settings values or infer boolean/domain semantics from their names.
